# Work Package Delivery Review Report Template

> Use this template to review a delivered or in-progress work package against its documented requirements, technical specification, delivery plan, repository instructions, and related wiki updates. Keep the review focused on overall delivery conformance; detailed test-hardening and refactoring-hardening work should remain in their specialist review flows.

## Review scope

- **Work package**: `<./docs/00x-work/...>`
- **Review depth**: `<quick|standard|deep>`
- **Reviewer perspective**: `Senior Delivery Reviewer`
- **Reviewed artifacts**:
  - `docs/...`
  - `src/...`
  - `test/...`

## Executive summary

- **Overall delivery confidence**: `<high|medium|low>`
- **Plan conformance assessment**: `<strong|partial|weak>`
- **Top concerns**:
  1. `<concern>`
  2. `<concern>`
  3. `<concern>`
